audit.whatIsWrong: diff says FAV but diffRating, breakdown.difficulty and report[14] all read 8.5/10 'Hard matchup'.
audit.why: Ornn records 54.96% over 3450 games and the chart ends with him owning the 2-item stage — the page contradicted itself on the headline number a user reads first.
audit.corrected: diffRating 8.5/10 to 6.5/10, with breakdown.difficulty and report[14] reworded to match; carryRating left at 8.5/10 because Lucian genuinely is that dangerous ahead.

audit.why: Packet levelChart is Lucian, Lucian, Lucian, Skill, Skill, Skill, Ornn, and mirror lucian__ornn already flipped row 4 to Skill and row 6 to Ornn. whys[4] on this page already said 'it's skill-decided' and whys[6] already described Ornn killing him — both layers disagreed with their own text.
audit.corrected: Rows 4 and 6 flipped in matched full/content pairs to Skill and Ornn; ratings moved with them.

audit.whatIsWrong: Relentless Pursuit is tracked all over the page but its cooldown is never given, and the thing that makes tracking it hard is never mentioned.
audit.why: Relentless Pursuit is 16s at rank 1 — a long window — but Lightslinger attacks actively reduce it, so the punish shrinks the longer he is hitting you. Ardent Blaze is 14s at 900 range and grants him move speed for attacking marked targets, which is how he leaves your Brittle range. Piercing Light is 9s at only 500 range; The Culling is 110s at 1400.
audit.corrected: The 16s-but-shrinking rule, the Ardent Blaze mark, and the 9s / 14s / 110s numbers written into the phases, trades and cooldown breakdown.

audit.whatIsWrong: No Grievous Wounds line despite Lightslinger being flagged as sustain.
audit.why: Ornn's plan here is a grind into a champion who heals through chip; anti-heal decides the extended trade.

edits.before: Q-poke and AA-trade — your base stats are quietly elite. Identify how Lucian contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Lightslinger double-shots and Piercing Light chip you at 500 range while you have no shield — take Q-tip CS and nothing else.

edits.before: W brittle turns every trade into bonus %HP damage. Only take the trade when Lucian's Relentless Pursuit is down.
edits.after: Still no answer: Ardent Blaze is 14s and its mark speeds him up for every hit. Farm at max range, do not contest.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Lucian must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: W lets you absorb one step-up, but his range and Relentless Pursuit still out-trade you. Stabilizing, not yours yet.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Relentless Pursuit's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Even now: E into your own Q pillar for the knock-up, then W-Brittle. His E is 16s at rank 1 — that is your window, so use it.

edits.before: Call of the Forge God re-engages a whole fight — and your forge prints item leads. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Lucian's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Call of the Forge God's knock-up beats his all-in, but a clean Relentless Pursuit still breaks your combo — this stage is decided on execution.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Lucian carry threat 8.5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on and his auto-DPS stops mattering — one E-Q knock-up into W-Brittle kills a Lucian who has spent his dash.

edits.before: Q the pillar behind Lucian, E-dash through it for the knockup when his answer is down, and W-brittle the trade for the proc.
edits.after: Q the pillar behind Lucian, E into it for the knockup, then W-Brittle — commit while Relentless Pursuit's 16s is spent.

edits.before: E-dashing with no terrain in the line — no knockup means you delivered yourself to his combo for free.
edits.after: E with no terrain in the line — no knockup, and he simply dashes out and double-shots you for free.

edits.before: His dash + reset. Engage when it's down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: 16s at rank 1, but every Lightslinger double-shot shaves it — punish fast.

edits.before: That is Lucian's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Ardent Blaze marks you and gives him move speed for hitting you — step out.

edits.before: - Lucian Relentless Pursuit: matchup-defining — His dash + reset. Engage when it's down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Lucian Relentless Pursuit: matchup-defining — 16s at rank 1, but Lightslinger double-shots shorten it, so punish immediately. - Piercing Light: 9s at 500 range. - The Culling: 110s at rank 1, 1400 range.

edits.before: Trade strictly around Relentless Pursuit: when it is down, run your full pattern; when it is up, give nothing. If behind, farm safe and let your spikes re-open the lane.
edits.after: Trade on the 16s Relentless Pursuit — but every double-shot he lands shortens it, so commit the moment it is spent, not two autos later. Anti-heal before any grind.

edits.before: Overall difficulty: 8.5/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Relentless Pursuit and how disciplined your pattern is.
edits.after: Overall difficulty: 6.5/10. Lucian owns levels 1-3; the lane is decided by whether you survive them without giving a kill.

edits.before: Hard matchup — difficulty 8.5/10, Lucian carry threat 8.5/10.
edits.after: Even matchup — difficulty 6.5/10, Lucian carry threat 8.5/10.

notes: tone is set to #ff5d6c (the red used for hard lanes) while diff says FAV and the win rate is 54.96% — the colour now disagrees with both the enum and the corrected 6.5/10 rating. tone is a writable enum field but I do not know the palette's token set, so I left it for a human sweep rather than guessing. As on the other Ornn pages, I did not restate the 'unstoppable / shield' claim for Bellows Breath, which Riot's kit text does not support.
